item.description:
Jot 0.7.1

Fixes how Jot recovers a meeting that failed to transcribe.

  • Retry rebuilds the whole meeting. When a recording that Audio Hijack split into several parts fails (say a provider was down or out of credits), pressing Retry now re-transcribes every part and files them as one transcript, one folder, and one Notion page. Previously only the first part was retried and the rest were left behind in the Watch Folder.
  • The Retry button clears itself. Once a retry succeeds, its failure row stops offering Retry, so it can no longer re-fire against an audio file that has already been moved.
  • Clearer "missing part" message. If a part is gone when you retry, Jot now says so plainly and points you to Manual Upload to rebuild the meeting, instead of failing with a cryptic "file not found".
